correctness.rationale: The factor-bit orthogonal transform exactly splits the weighted cube Laplacian into L(Q_m) and L(Q_m)+2I+2(c-1)e0e0^T. The first block contributes m+1 distinct visible Walsh levels. In the second block all nonradial levels coincide with these, whereas the m+1 radial Jacobi eigenvalues are simple and disjoint from them when c>0,c!=1; positivity excludes zero. Jacobi zero-coordinate eigenvectors are equivalent to common eigenvalues of two irreducible principal blocks. Affine-in-c interlacing proves finite exception count. Exact 4-cube exceptions verified algebraically; 489 exact checker assertions completed on actual script path.

value.rationale: Single-vertex reachable dimension quantifies how many independent state directions can be influenced under a fixed actuator, a natural control-system invariant. The exact answer across an exponentially large graph family quantifies a localized symmetry break from \(d+1\) to \(2d\) and detects isolated algebraic conductance resonances; it provides a meaningful actuator-location and perturbation-sensitivity classification even without multi-input optimization.
